source_snapshot.procedure: Run fio on all drives for 43200 seconds with 4K randrw, 32 jobs depending on CPU design, 4G size and iodepth 32; collect results and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains functional, logs contain no unexpected error and IOPS reaches at least 80% of the theoretical specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL only checks fio version and warns about sustained I/O; it never defines or runs the source workload, protects data, monitors health or calculates the 80% threshold.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly gates the long run but a version probe is not test execution and provides none of the required performance or reliability evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores the 12-hour mixed workload and adds target, file, spec, thermal, health and cleanup controls.
historical_reviews.related_cases: This case measures sustained fio reliability and 80%-of-spec IOPS, not capacity exhaustion, simple enumeration or hot-add.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Every drive needs an explicit stable identity, independent target/file allocation and per-device result; aggregate output cannot hide one failed or slower device.

original_test_intent: Stress every approved SSD with the defined 12-hour 4K random mixed fio profile, verify system and storage reliability, and confirm each applicable result meets at least 80% of the approved theoretical IOPS specification.
original_method: After exact target and data-scope approval, start tracked fio jobs on isolated files or dedicated volumes for all mapped drives using the approved source parameters, continuously collect per-drive performance, latency, errors, health and system logs, then stop and clean only manifested artifacts.
manual_activity: User approves every target, fio semantics, endurance/thermal limits and performance baseline; operator confirms backup and recovery readiness; agent controls and monitors only the approved tracked jobs.
required_inputs: Per-drive serial/NGUID, controller, mount/filesystem and isolated test-file or dedicated-volume map
Pinned fio version/job and exact randrw mix, numjobs policy, iodepth, size, direct/sync/cache and grouping semantics
Per-drive theoretical IOPS source and 80% calculation method
Free-space, endurance, thermal, latency, error and host-responsiveness abort thresholds
Backup, cleanup, cooling/power, OOB/console and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Resolve all targets by stable identity and exclude boot, EFI, swap, RAID member, production and unknown raw devices
Use only approved isolated files or disposable volumes and verify aggregate file allocation cannot exceed free-space reserve
Monitor per-drive SMART/NVMe/controller health, temperature, latency, kernel/storage errors and host responsiveness throughout 12 hours
Preserve baseline logs and stop all tracked jobs on data-integrity, I/O, health, thermal, power, filesystem or monitoring failure
Do not auto-repair, remount, reboot, rerun or delete anything outside the test manifest
agent_execution_scope: Validate fio version and exact rendered job against the approved matrix
Launch and track per-drive jobs, PIDs and timestamps with complete JSON/text output
Collect per-drive IOPS, bandwidth, latency percentiles, errors, health/temperature and complete system logs over time
Stop cleanly and remove only approved test artifacts; do not select targets or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve targets, fio semantics, spec baseline, data/endurance/thermal and recovery boundaries
Own any storage/filesystem recovery or abnormal-stop decision
Review every drive's 12-hour evidence and 80%-of-spec calculation and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: fio --version is a prerequisite check only; it does not exercise the 43200-second all-drive workload or produce IOPS, stability, health and log acceptance evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Render and archive an approved fio job for each stable target using time_based runtime=43200, bs=4K, randrw, approved mix, numjobs policy, size=4g and iodepth=32, with isolated files, JSON output and continuous per-drive health monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The all-drive 12-hour, 4K randrw, source numjobs=32 depending on CPU design, 4G size, iodepth32 and 80%-of-theoretical criterion are explicitly preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run synchronized but independently attributable fio jobs with a precomputed per-drive acceptance table and continuous safety telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes ambiguous fio semantics and theoretical baseline explicit, protects data and produces per-drive rather than aggregate evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No source duration or load parameter is reduced; any CPU-dependent job-count change requires approval and remains recorded.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Filesystem cache, controller cache, job sharing and NUMA placement can materially change IOPS; the approved baseline must use the same measurement model.

project_override_considerations: If simultaneous all-drive loading is required, power and thermal headroom plus controller bottlenecks must be part of the expected model; sequential runs are not equivalent without approval.
expected_evidence: Pinned fio version and exact archived job file
Complete 12-hour per-drive JSON/text, IOPS, bandwidth, latency, errors and exit status
80%-of-theoretical calculation with authoritative source for each drive/profile
Time-series free space, SMART/NVMe/controller health, temperature, host responsiveness and dmesg/syslog/SEL
Test-file manifest, cleanup/restored state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master Procedure and Criteria consistently specify the fio reliability and performance workload. DeepSeek's version-only command is incomplete review coverage, not an ambiguity in the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Targets, job semantics, specifications and recovery controls are high-risk execution inputs that can be supplied; the static review is determinable.

review_improvement: Restores the actual all-drive 12-hour profile and adds per-drive data safety, acceptance math, telemetry, cleanup and recovery that a version check cannot provide.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fio performance depends on target type, read/write mix, cache/direct settings, file sharing, queue construction and NUMA/controller topology. A nominal 4K randrw label and aggregate IOPS are therefore insufficient; the exact job and theoretical reference must be fixed, while stable target identity and per-drive health/performance evidence prevent one device's failure from being averaged away.
